description:
High school student from Uralsk on the Field Shift challenge. I'm building a low-cost Arduino station that measures soil moisture in the steppe and combines it with NASA SMAP & POWER data to help West Kazakhstan farmers adapt to drought. I bring hardware and real ground data. Looking for: Python coding, data analysis, web dev. Join to build something real!
Ищу программистов и тех, кто работает с данными.
